articles.title: Get In, We’re Going to the Moon: Meet NASA’s Artemis Closeout Crew
articles.summary: For most, getting into a car is a task that can be done without assistance. Yet for those whose destination is the Moon, the process of getting inside and secured – in this case, in NASA’s Orion spacecraft – requires help. That’s the role of the Artemis closeout crew. articles.title: NASA Astronaut Nick Hague Retires
articles.summary: NASA astronaut Brig. Gen. Nick Hague has retired from the agency, concluding a distinguished career that included two spaceflight missions, 374 days in space, and multiple spacewalks in support of the International Space Station.
